edge_cases.mitigation: place an interim unit of a supported class with the client's agreement, record the class as spare-deficient, and stop placing that class until the pool is sized

edge_cases.description: The suite requires badge escort and the only authorized contact is away, so the stop cannot be completed
edge_cases.trigger: arrival at a stop whose access depends on one absent individual
edge_cases.mitigation: record the aborted stop with its cause, obtain a second authorized contact or a standing access arrangement, and reschedule inside the same cycle rather than skipping it

edge_cases.description: A new placement is won in a quadrant no day zone covers, and a service day has already been promised
edge_cases.trigger: an account signed and scheduled before the zone map was consulted
edge_cases.mitigation: record the out-of-zone decision and the day it burdens, set the cadence at the longest interval storage and freshness allow, and treat the account as a seed only if more density is realistically reachable

edge_cases.description: A core coffee or creamer line is discontinued or back-ordered by the supplier mid-cycle
edge_cases.trigger: a supplier notice or a short shipment at receiving
edge_cases.mitigation: substitute only within the same format and disclose the substitution to affected accounts rather than swapping silently, and raise the reorder point once lead-time reliability is known

edge_cases.description: The driver observes that one person is taking product home, inflating apparent draw-down at an otherwise ordinary account
edge_cases.trigger: consumption that jumps without any headcount or usage change the room can explain
edge_cases.mitigation: report the pattern factually to the site contact without accusation, hold par at the consumption the room actually uses, and let the client decide how to handle their own premises

edge_cases.description: A slow leak is discovered days after a plumbed install, with water damage inside the tenant's casework
edge_cases.trigger: a client report of damp, a facilities escalation, or a leak sensor alarm
edge_cases.mitigation: isolate at the local shutoff immediately, document the connection and its inspection record, escalate through the operator's own insurer and the building's process, and review whether the tap method and containment standard need to change fleet-wide

edge_cases.description: A building or health inspector asks the driver on the spot for documentation covering the beverage equipment and the person servicing it
edge_cases.trigger: an inspection, a building audit, or a tenant's compliance review
edge_cases.mitigation: carry the obligation register's current documents and the per-serial maintenance record in the vehicle, answer only from what is documented, and refer anything unverified back to the office rather than improvising a compliance claim

edge_cases.description: The route vehicle is off the road or the regular driver is unavailable on a day carrying several time-window-bound stops
edge_cases.trigger: a breakdown, an accident or an unplanned absence on a scheduled route day
edge_cases.mitigation: triage the day by consumption risk rather than by sequence - accounts closest to a stock-out and any down machine are served first by a covering driver or a partial run, the rest are rescheduled inside their access windows with the site contacts told the same day, and the disruption is logged so a repeat pattern is treated as a cadence or coverage problem rather than bad luck

workflow.action: Fix the placement definition-of-done for this account
workflow.description: State what installed and serving means here, who owns the equipment, who the site contact is, and what the standing service promise covers
workflow.artifact: placement done-state checklist for the account
workflow.gate: the checklist names the done-state items, the equipment ownership boundary and a named contact with an escalation path

workflow.action: Verify the local sanitation, water and trade-obligation classes
workflow.description: Identify each obligation class that applies to this jurisdiction, this building and this equipment, and record who was asked and when
workflow.artifact: dated local obligation register with retained documents
workflow.gate: every class lists its authority, verification date and held document, and nothing is relied on that was not verified locally

workflow.action: Survey every breakroom and capture the blocking constraints
workflow.description: Measure space, power, water, drain, storage and the access path per room, photograph them, and identify the contact who controls the room
workflow.artifact: site survey record with measurements and photographs
workflow.gate: each room has measured findings, an access-path note with hours, and an explicit list of install-blocking items

workflow.action: Build the consumption profile from sourced input bands
workflow.description: Derive expected draw-down per category from on-site headcount, drink mix and visitor traffic, recording the evidence behind every band
workflow.artifact: consumption profile worksheet with sourced assumptions
workflow.gate: every input band names its evidence source and the profile is explicitly marked as an estimate to be replaced by measurement

workflow.action: Test the supply point and set the filtration class and interval
workflow.description: Sample the line the equipment will use, record hardness, dissolved solids, chlorine and sediment, and derive filter stages and change interval from throughput
workflow.artifact: dated water test result with filtration specification
workflow.gate: the test names the sampled point and date, and the filter and descale intervals are expressed as functions of measured throughput

workflow.action: Specify the brewer and water-system classes
workflow.description: Match class to peak demand, footprint, power, water and cleaning minutes, confirm consumable format compatibility and spare availability, and settle bottled versus plumbed
workflow.artifact: equipment specification sheet for the placement
workflow.gate: the specification is justified against demand and room constraints, uses an existing consumable format, and has a spare of its class available

workflow.action: Confirm utility readiness and the licensed-trade boundary
workflow.description: Arrange the tap, shutoff, backflow protection, drainage, containment and circuit, and confirm which work requires a licensed trade in this jurisdiction and building
workflow.artifact: install readiness checklist with trade confirmations
workflow.gate: the connection point, protection class, containment and circuit are confirmed in writing and any licensed-trade work is booked with its record

workflow.action: Install, brew to spec, lay out the station and hand over
workflow.description: Flush lines and filters, calibrate and taste the brew on the client's water, sanitize contact surfaces, lay out the station, walk the client through use and capture sign-off
workflow.artifact: signed handover record with serials, filter dates and opening par
workflow.gate: flush, calibration, sanitizing, layout photographs, serials, contact and agreed service day are all present on the record

workflow.action: Set the account catalog and opening par under the honest-stocking rule
workflow.description: Select catalog items for the placed machines and set per-item par from the profile, capped by measured storage and the freshness window, with the client's agreement
workflow.artifact: per-account par sheet with derivation and agreement date
workflow.gate: every par line shows its cycle length, source draw-down or estimate, storage and freshness caps, and a dated client agreement

workflow.action: Set the cadence and place the stop in a day zone
workflow.description: Derive cycle length from par, storage and freshness, then assign the account to an existing day zone or record the out-of-zone decision explicitly
workflow.artifact: cadence decision with route day and zone assignment
workflow.gate: the cycle length is derived rather than assumed and the account has a named day zone or a recorded out-of-zone decision

workflow.action: Build the load-out plan and the per-serial maintenance schedule
workflow.description: Create the pick list from par minus expected on-hand, size the buffer, load parts, filters and a spare of the placed class, and schedule the preventive tasks that ride along on stops
workflow.artifact: pick list plus per-serial preventive-maintenance schedule
workflow.gate: the load traces to par minus on-hand with a stated buffer, and each placed serial has scheduled tasks with intervals justified by water and throughput

workflow.action: Close the first cycles and hand the records downstream
workflow.description: Aggregate the first cycles' on-hand and delivered counts, reset par and cadence from measured draw-down, and pass the records to stop-level economics and retention work
workflow.artifact: first-cycle recalibration record and handoff data set
workflow.gate: measured draw-down replaces the estimate, every par or cadence change is logged with its reason, and the record set is complete in the agreed handoff format

priority_rationale: The frame units come first because the placement done-state, the locally verified obligation register and the measured room decide what may legally and physically be placed at all; consumption and water testing then convert the room into the two measurements every equipment choice rests on; equipment class, utility readiness, install and asset registration turn those measurements into a physically serving placement; catalog, par and the honest-stocking constraint set what the room holds; cadence, territory, sequencing, truck load and depot replenishment convert the placement into a repeatable route, which is where the operation's cost actually lives; and maintenance, failure response, the driver standard and the per-stop record come last because they are the loops that keep the placement alive and feed measured evidence back into every earlier unit.

dominance_rules.rule: Safety and building-damage prevention dominate install speed
dominance_rules.rationale: a leak inside a tenant's casework or an overloaded circuit can cost more than the account will earn in its lifetime and can end the relationship with the building, not just the client
dominance_rules.trigger: a shortcut on tapping, containment, protection class or circuit capacity is proposed to hold an install date
dominance_rules.action: refuse the shortcut, use the compliant method or licensed trade, and reschedule the install with the client informed of why

dominance_rules.rule: A dated local verification dominates assumed or imported practice
dominance_rules.rationale: sanitation, water-connection and trade-licensing requirements differ by jurisdiction and by building, and an assumption carried from another territory is not a defence
dominance_rules.trigger: any requirement is uncertain, or the route enters a new city, county or building with its own vendor rules
dominance_rules.action: verify with the responsible authority or property manager, record the date and document, and hold the placement until the answer is in the register

dominance_rules.rule: Measured draw-down dominates the estimated consumption profile once cycles exist
dominance_rules.rationale: the estimate is a seeding device built from bands, while draw-down is observation of the actual room
dominance_rules.trigger: measured on-hand and delivered counts disagree with the profile that set the opening par
dominance_rules.action: reset par and cadence to the measured values and log the variance against the original estimate

dominance_rules.rule: The client's agreed stock level dominates route convenience
dominance_rules.rationale: the business is a recurring relationship in someone else's breakroom, and unrequested product is the fastest way to turn a satisfied account into a resentful one
dominance_rules.trigger: dropping more than the agreed quantity would let the route skip a visit
dominance_rules.action: keep the agreed quantity, and seek the saving through a cadence, format or zoning change disclosed to the client

dominance_rules.rule: Storage capacity and the freshness window dominate cadence stretching
dominance_rules.rationale: a cycle the shelf or the product cannot survive produces stock-outs or stale coffee, both of which cost more than the visit saved
dominance_rules.trigger: extending the cycle would require a par larger than measured storage or older than the shortest freshness window
dominance_rules.action: hold the cadence, or change format or item mix to one whose storage and shelf life support the longer cycle

dominance_rules.rationale: a stop that cannot be entered produces nothing and must be repeated, which costs far more than the driving that a tidy sequence would have saved
dominance_rules.trigger: the shortest sequence would arrive outside a building's or contact's access window
dominance_rules.action: sequence to the hard windows first and absorb the additional driving between them

dominance_rules.rule: A down machine at a placed account dominates routine restocking that day
dominance_rules.rationale: the standing promise is that the machine works, and a room with product but no working brewer is a failed placement
dominance_rules.trigger: a failure call and a scheduled routine stop compete for the same hours
dominance_rules.action: restore or swap the failed unit first, re-plan the day against hard windows, and record the displaced stops

dominance_rules.rule: Water-condition evidence dominates calendar maintenance intervals
dominance_rules.rationale: scale and filter exhaustion track water condition and throughput, not the page of a schedule
dominance_rules.trigger: the measured hardness or throughput at an account implies a shorter interval than the standard schedule
dominance_rules.action: shorten the interval for that serial, record the justification, and review the machine class if the interval becomes impractical

dominance_rules.rationale: a fleet that cannot be located or whose maintenance history is detached from its serials cannot be maintained, recovered or costed
dominance_rules.trigger: a unit is moved, swapped, benched or retired during a route day
dominance_rules.action: no unit changes location or status without the register entry being updated the same day

anti_rework_rules.rule: Survey the room and test the actual supply point before specifying any equipment
anti_rework_rules.prevents: return trips with a machine that will not fit the counter, the circuit or the water, and a filtration class chosen for water the machine never sees

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify the local sanitation and trade-licensing obligation classes before booking install work
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an install that has to be undone or redone because an inspection, a permit class or a building vendor rule surfaces afterwards

anti_rework_rules.rule: Choose machine classes that use a consumable format the catalog already carries
anti_rework_rules.prevents: orphaned single-account SKUs, fragmented spares and a truck that must carry a format for one stop

anti_rework_rules.rule: Seed par from the profile but lock it only after a full measured cycle
anti_rework_rules.prevents: rebuilding every par sheet and carrying stale product back off the route when the estimate proves wrong

anti_rework_rules.rule: Set the cadence before assigning the account to a day zone
anti_rework_rules.prevents: re-cutting whole route days when a cycle length changes after the stop has been slotted

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm the day zone before promising the client a service day
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a promise that strands a stop outside every zone and forces a territory re-cut or a broken commitment

anti_rework_rules.rule: Build the load from par minus verified on-hand rather than from memory
anti_rework_rules.prevents: second trips for missed items and carrying back product the account never needed

anti_rework_rules.rule: Record serials, filters and dates at handover rather than at month end
anti_rework_rules.prevents: untraceable equipment, lost maintenance history and disputes about what was actually installed

anti_rework_rules.rule: Derive the maintenance intervals from the install-day water test
anti_rework_rules.prevents: descale emergencies and premature failures that turn planned stops into unscheduled detours

anti_rework_rules.rule: Count on-hand before restocking from the very first stop
anti_rework_rules.prevents: arriving at the first par review with no draw-down history and having to guess a second time

iteration_protocol.trigger: the first full service cycles are complete at a new placement
iteration_protocol.action: recompute draw-down from on-hand and delivered counts, reset par and cadence to the measured values, and log the variance against the opening estimate

iteration_protocol.trigger: a stock-out is reported or found at a stop
iteration_protocol.action: determine whether par, cycle length or the day's load-out failed, fix that specific cause, and record which one it was

iteration_protocol.trigger: aged or discarded product is found on a client's shelf
iteration_protocol.action: cut the par or change the item format, remove the slow-moving line with the client's agreement, and check the account against the honest-stocking rule

iteration_protocol.trigger: repeated faults appear on one machine class, one serial or one water condition
iteration_protocol.action: re-examine the water test and maintenance interval first, then the class selection and the spare pool sizing for that class

iteration_protocol.trigger: the client's headcount, floor plan or on-site-days policy changes
iteration_protocol.action: rebuild the consumption profile, re-check whether the equipment class still fits peak demand, and reset par and cadence

iteration_protocol.trigger: new placements or cancellations shift the density of a day zone
iteration_protocol.action: re-evaluate the zone and day assignments and the sequence before promising any new service day in that area

iteration_protocol.trigger: end-of-day reconciliation or cycle counts show recurring variance
iteration_protocol.action: audit the pick list, the stop records and depot receiving in that order, and tighten the specific step that is producing the drift

iteration_protocol.trigger: a jurisdiction, building rule or training class changes or approaches expiry
iteration_protocol.action: re-verify the affected entries in the obligation register and retrain or re-document before the next stop in that territory
